text: You mentioned you wanted to talk about internships. What kind of position are you hoping for? I would like something in marketing, ideally at a company where I could work on real campaigns. Good goal. Have you updated your resume since you finished your statistics project last term? Not yet, but I will add the statistics project and my volunteer work this week. Do that soon, because the application deadline for most summer programs is at the end of March. Then I will submit everything before the middle of March to be safe. Tailor your cover letter to each company rather than sending exactly the same one. I will explain how my experience relates to each company’s work. Send me a draft of your resume when it is ready, and I can give you feedback. Thank you. I will update it this week and send you a draft.
